jurisdictions.name: Federal
jurisdictions.note: Corporations Canada includes the corporate name search in the standard online incorporation process.

jurisdictions.name: British Columbia
jurisdictions.note: A numbered BC company can use its assigned incorporation number. A word name requires name approval. The amounts here are basic registry fees. BC OnLine also lists a $1.50 service charge per applicable transaction.
sources: BC registry filing and name fees

jurisdictions.name: Ontario
jurisdictions.note: For a word name, Ontario requires an Ontario-biased or weighted Nuans report from a private supplier. Add the price quoted by your supplier. A numbered corporation can skip the report.

jurisdictions.name: Nova Scotia
jurisdictions.note: The word-name example uses an Atlantic region name search. A Canada-wide search costs $75.58 instead. With a qualifying Nuans report already in hand, the registry charges $15.12 for either search. Reserving a numbered company name is free.
sources: Registry of Joint Stock Companies incorporation fee
Nova Scotia name reservation fees and exceptions
